scope: Focused Windows actual Chromium/compiled Architect shell, fake authority/executors, no inference; these composed checks are not complete normative UX/GE acceptance

checks.name: B25-01
checks.detail: Actual 1,000 variable-height rows restore selected plan by ID and center only the rail.

checks.name: B25-02
checks.detail: Filtering preserves active plan; explicit reveal adds one labelled row without clearing filters or substituting first plan.

checks.name: B25-03
checks.detail: Background list/detail refresh retains rail scroll instead of stealing focus.

checks.name: B25-04
checks.detail: Menu retains captured plan after selection changes; Ask creates an editable draft without sending or mutating.

checks.name: B25-05
checks.detail: Native text-input menu/draft remains intact.

checks.name: B25-06
checks.detail: Shift-F10, Home/End, type-ahead and Escape work with focus restoration.

checks.name: B25-07
checks.detail: Captured CAS command rejects changed revision; it cannot silently target the newly selected plan.

checks.name: B25-08
checks.detail: Out-of-order detail loads and delayed reveal ignore stale selection.

checks.name: B25-09
checks.detail: Explicit disclosure chevron and per-plan open state survive lifecycle refresh.

checks.name: B25-10
checks.detail: Narrow/reduced-motion menu stays inside viewport, with touch-visible overflow styling.

checks.name: B25-11
checks.detail: Offline refresh retains the as-of view and exposes failure; reconnect rereads canonical state.

checks.name: B25-12
checks.detail: Sibling overflow controls and slice/concern menus retain native card interactions without nested buttons.

checks.name: B25-13
checks.detail: Actual delayed preference persistence keeps chat bound to its original plan; result cannot refresh the new selection, and mismatched continuation dispatch is stopped.

checks.name: B25-14
checks.detail: Actual approval preview race stops before any lifecycle mutation; the newly selected plan cannot inherit another plan’s reviewed scope.

checks.name: B25-15
checks.detail: Exact review retains literal Unicode/source arguments and original execution/receipt/revision when selected plan changes; no source markup is executed.

checks.name: B25-16
checks.detail: Lost acknowledgement retains exact ID/payload across stop and another execution event; continuation is fenced, retry cannot switch target, and confirmed acknowledgement clears the obsolete blocking status.

checks.name: B25-17
checks.detail: Decline addresses only the captured proposal and issues no approval.

checks.name: B25-18
checks.detail: Narrow review is within the viewport with visible native disclosure, complete scrollable detail, and no approval after the request disappears.

checks.name: B25-19
checks.detail: Streamed inspection over the independent UTF-8 byte ceiling refuses without clipping evidence, changing the captured target, or issuing another approval.

checks.name: B25-20
checks.detail: Read-only original-execution recovery keeps unknown closure fenced and literal, disables revoked approval, and releases the acknowledgement fence only for a declared settled inactive closure without another effect/approval.

checks.name: B25-21
checks.detail: Concern review keeps the unique canonical source anchor, original plan and existing draft, without sending or resolving status from prose.

checks.name: B25-22
checks.detail: ADR menu opens the existing proposal editor; changing plan before submit refuses the original draft without writing a proposal against a replacement plan.

checks.name: B25-23
checks.detail: Schedule menu opens the actual v2 workspace at its exact captured definition; unlinked plan/slice remain null and edit navigation enqueues no job or model work.

checks.name: B25-24
checks.detail: Source file/heading references remain literal unattested evidence, rather than fabricated graph entity identities, and only draft a question.

checks.name: B25-25
checks.detail: One menu activation dispatches once even for queued duplicate clicks; replacing its invoking row invalidates the old popup.

checks.name: B25-26
checks.detail: A real renamed row above the visible 1,000-plan rail changes height without moving the logical visible plan or its offset.

checks.name: B25-27
checks.detail: Actual Chromium touch input discovers overflow and taps a target-bound draft without a long-press, right-click or send.
